assertions.assertion: Identifies that storage configuration must be inside the AddUserManagement() options lambda
assertions.rationale: The response states directly that storage must be configured inside the AddUserManagement() options lambda, not on builder.Services or the IdentityServer builder.

assertions.assertion: Shows the correct pattern: AddUserManagement(options => { options.AddSqliteStore(...); })
assertions.rationale: It shows the corrected code with options.AddSqliteStore("Data Source=users.db") inside the AddUserManagement(options => { ... }) lambda.

assertions.assertion: Explains that configuring storage outside the lambda is the cause of the error
assertions.rationale: It explains that top-level storage registration isn't attached to the User Management options, so the store can't be resolved — the cause of the error.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT suggest using EF Core migrations as a fix
assertions.rationale: It explicitly warns against reaching for EF Core migrations, noting storage is document-based and schema is created via CreateIfNotExistsAsync().
